data.description:
## Goal

As a ToneForge maintainer I want every local relative link in the recipe book to resolve, and a test that fails when one breaks, so the book cannot silently drift into 404s.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 1 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

`docs/recipe-book/` contains zero broken local relative links (currently 121 broken links across 111 pages), enforced by a link-integrity test that covers `index.md`, `_template.md`, the 100 recipe pages and the 10 capstone pages.

## Definition of done

- The generated `## See also` links target real files: `../../tonegraph.md` → `../tonegraph.md` (101 pages, including `_template.md`) and `../../prd/STACK_PRD.md` / `../../prd/SEQUENCER_PRD.md` → `../prd/…` (10 capstone pages).
- The corrections live in the generators (`scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts`, `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts`); `_template.md` is hand-maintained — no script emits it — so it is edited directly and that is recorded in a code comment.
- Affected pages are regenerated and a second regeneration is byte-identical.
- A link-integrity test in `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` resolves every inline link relative to its page and fails with the offending page + target.
- `npx vitest run src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` passes.

## Constraints

- Fix the generators and regenerate; do not hand-edit generated pages. `_template.md` is the only direct page edit (it has no generator).
- No changes to recipe YAML, roster, registry or sound design.
- Preserve front matter, roster order, tier structure and every existing green gate; UK English throughout.

## Risky assumptions

- The book uses only inline `[text](target)` links. Mitigation: the test asserts the number of parsed links, so reference-style links cannot slip through unparsed.
- Anchor-only links (`#section`), absolute URLs and external hosts are out of scope for resolution.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All local relative links in `docs/recipe-book/` resolve: a link-integrity check (new or extended) passes for `index.md`, `_template.md`, all 100 recipe pages and all 10 capstone pages, with zero broken local targets.
- `../../tonegraph.md` no longer appears in any recipe-book page and `../../prd/` no longer appears in any capstone page; the generator sources are corrected so regeneration reproduces the correct links.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` resolves every inline link relative to its page, skips `#fragment`s, absolute URLs and external hosts, and reports the offending page and target on failure.
- Regenerating with `tsx scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` and `tsx scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` twice produces byte-identical output, leaving `git status --porcelain docs/recipe-book` clean.
- The recipe-book test file passes.

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — fix the `../../tonegraph.md` target.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — fix the `../../prd/…` targets.
- `docs/recipe-book/_template.md` — hand-maintained template; fix the `../../tonegraph.md` target.
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` — index plus the 100 recipe and 10 capstone pages as regenerated output.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — link-integrity gate.

## Dependencies

None — this is the first slice and unblocks the CLI-block slices.

## Deliverables

Correct link targets in the generators and the template, regenerated pages, and a link-integrity gate in the recipe-book test battery.
data.title: Recipe-book link integrity gate and correct link targets
